title: Universal Media Decomposer plan decomposition
body: Created six sequential implementation plans A-F because the approved DD/final estimate classify the work as EPIC and a single plan would exceed manager/worker validation scope. A establishes the shared reducer, semantic ledger, OCFL, migrations, locators, and provenance; B adds Hatchet-only durable jobs plus text/image; C adds sandbox/providers plus audio/video/independent subtitles; D adds reversible resolution/alignment, replay projections, search/query/API; E adds operations/deployment/docs/extension gates; F owns full matrix and correction→invalidation→selective-rerun cross-tier E2E. Created shared README and CONTRACTS.md because no prior plan/contract artifacts existed. Support-Librarian confirmed DD_REQUIRED IMMUTABLE, T1-T8 complete, AMEND_AND_PASS approval, no ADR/ASR infrastructure, and open gates must remain explicit. Plan parser validation passed for every phase of all six plans.

title: Amended Plan D for Round 2 QA remediation
body: Appended additive Phase 4 to TASK-universal-media-decomposer-D-resolution-query-api. Phase 4 has 10 flat steps covering indexed continuity/temporal/spatial filtering with explicit 422 for unmappable scope, REST Resolver wiring and merge/split contract tests, segment-scoped evidence retrieval and test, plus final focused/full verification. Existing Phases 1-3 and all completed annotations were preserved; no contracts or README changes were needed because this is an additive remediation phase within Plan D.

Add direct app_factory/build_source_store and deterministic /v1/ready rebuild-in-progress 503 coverage, correct provider labels, test-count/failure disclosures, and 23-table documentation. Preserve all existing completed steps and no Plan F work.

title: Production remediation plan decomposition
body: Existing A-F are historical complete but leave production API fake completion, uncomposed StageWork, Hatchet seam, provider activation, absent hosted Docker CI, and internal-only E2E. Chosen four dependency-ordered remediation plans G-J: G production stage registry/runner/API ingestion; H Hatchet exact pin and real worker binding; I local provider activation and modality composition; J public API-boundary E2E, hosted GitHub Actions Docker matrix, measured docs, final adversarial QA/release. Hatchet remains sole scheduler; no hand-rolled competing loop. Permitted gates remain explicit and CI-proven.

title: Plans validated
body: Created and plan_read-validated four remediation plans G-J. Each has four sequential phases, flat spec-first steps, explicit completion criteria, and dependency order. Shared CONTRACTS adds production registry, production runner, Hatchet worker, and capability reporter interfaces; parts README adds G-J dependency graph. Weighted context estimates remain below worker/manager limits: G 2432, H 2302, I 1864, J 2221 (DS_V4_F_0731 worst-case for requested ranges).

body: Amended TASK-universal-media-decomposer-G-production-runner-api narrowly for QA-Reviewer PLANNING_GAP F1. title: Selected Workflow durable-task DAG for Plan K amendment 3
body: Support-Researcher verified hatchet-sdk 1.38.1 exposes one Workflow with Workflow.durable_task(parents=[Task]) and serializes CreateTaskOpts.parents (field 5) plus is_durable (field 14) into one CreateWorkflowVersionRequest; standalone durable_task hardcodes parents=[]. Chose the registration-time intra-workflow graph as the implementation topology: nine task names umd-<stage>, direct STAGE_DEPENDENCIES parents, one worker workflow registration and one workflow-level run submission. SDK expressibility is source-verified; server v0.105.2 persistence and completion-gated dispatch remain mandatory hosted probe gates. parent_id is rejected and parent_step_run_id remains unproven/singular. Amending only Plan K; CONTRACTS.md unchanged.
